# KeronisEngine

> C++20 trading engine with streaming feature state machines and in-process ONNX Runtime inference. Runs full-exchange crypto feeds (10,000+ msg/s) on a single ~$100 dedicated server. Apache-2.0 licensed.

## Full documentation bundle

- [llms-full.txt](https://engine.keronis.ai/llms-full.txt): All documentation pages concatenated in Markdown.
